description: This file defines the ImplementedInterfaceProvider class, which populates grain interface properties with the interfaces implemented by a grain class in the Orleans framework. It includes methods for populating properties, checking if a type is a grain interface, and resolving interface types.

classes.name: ImplementedInterfaceProvider
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to populate grain interface properties based on the interfaces implemented by a grain class.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates the properties dictionary with interface IDs for each grain interface implemented by the specified grain class.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Generates a property key string based on the interface index.

methods.name: IsGrainInterface
methods.description: Determines whether a given type is a grain interface type, excluding certain system and marker interfaces.
